summary: BidVex P0+P1 Escrow & Penalties Features - All features tested and verified. Fixed critical bug in AdminEscrowManager (API URL path and array type checking). Backend APIs working correctly. Admin Dashboard 'Escrow & Penalties' tab renders AdminEscrowManager with 5 stats cards and 3 sub-tabs. Seller and Buyer dashboards show escrow empty states correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: AdminEscrowManager.js had incorrect API URLs - changed from /admin/escrow/* to /escrow/admin/escrow/* to match backend routes
FIXED: AdminEscrowManager.js needed Array.isArray() checks to prevent 's.filter is not a function' error when API returns non-array
AdminEscrowManager correctly shows 5 stats cards: Total Escrows, Held, Released, Disputes, Penalties
AdminEscrowManager has 3 sub-tabs: Escrow Transactions, Disputes, Penalty Log
Seller Dashboard 'Escrow & Pickup' tab shows empty state with data-testid='seller-escrow-empty'
Buyer Dashboard 'Escrow' tab shows empty state with data-testid='buyer-escrow-empty'
All escrow endpoints properly require authentication (401 for unauthenticated)
Admin escrow endpoints properly require admin role (403 for non-admin)

success_rate.backend: 100% (10 passed, 3 skipped - non-admin tests skipped due to registration requirements)
